name: postsharp
description: PostSharp documentation and tools for aspect-oriented programming in C#

plugins.name: postsharp
plugins.description: Complete PostSharp documentation for aspect-oriented programming in C#, covering custom aspects (OnMethodBoundaryAspect, MethodInterceptionAspect, LocationInterceptionAspect, EventInterceptionAspect), attribute multicasting, architecture constraints, and the PostSharp Patterns libraries (caching, logging, threading models, contracts, INotifyPropertyChanged, XAML). Use whenever writing, reviewing, or debugging code in a project that references PostSharp packages; when a build reports PostSharp errors or warnings (PS, LA, SR, AR, COM, DOM, THR, XAM, CAC or DIA codes, each documented in an article); when configuring PostSharp MSBuild properties, postsharp.config, licensing, or deployment on a build server; or when maintaining an existing PostSharp code base, including explaining which aspects apply to a member and why woven code behaves differently from its source.
